rows.text: (A guest? Wonder who it could be...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm like the Express's gossip queen, but when it comes to Himeko's past, I'm totally in the dark. I even asked Mr. Yang about it, but all he said was: "I don't know anything about this, either."
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Might as well think of it as a gift: a celebration feast for allies, and a well-deserved vacation.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It's the crown jewel of Epsilon, headquarters of Interastral Peace Entertainment.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Defeating Irontomb is, of course, a feat worthy of being recorded in the history books. It's something that belongs to the cosmos, and even more so to the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Getting to visit the Interastral Peace Entertainment headquarters AND become the leaders of the Anti-Destruction Alliance...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, when has anything that good ever just fallen into someone's lap?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Jade is a shrewd businesswoman. Her idea of a "leader" might not align with what we have in mind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What do you think, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: See? I told you [Trailblazer] wouldn't agree either.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This responsibility is too heavy to bear. Even if it makes sense, we must proceed with caution.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Why? Mind telling us your reasons?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Would you like to hear the data bank records, or just the rumors I've heard?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's check the data bank.
Spill the tea.
I don't have any other questions.
We should agree for now and take things one step at a time.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Well, you're not exactly wrong if you put it that way...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But it's still better not to take any risks. This responsibility is too heavy to bear. Even if it makes sense, we must proceed with caution.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Besides, it goes against our identity as free people of the Express. Once we accept, the nature of the Trailblaze would completely change.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Anyway, we should politely decline for now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Sunday, what does your gut tell you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: From what I know about Madam Jade, every favor she does is just groundwork to put things in her control.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: She told me a legend: Aha the Elation once shed a tear there, and thus bestowed a blessing upon the whole world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I feel the same way. The IPC even wants the Express to spearhead an alliance...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: They're probably trying to use us.
They want to make the Trailblaze the boss.
I assume there's more to it than that.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: According to her, the IPC sees the Trailblaze as something to rally behind.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Riding on the Cosmic Alliance's victory over Irontomb, having us step up to organize an alliance and integrate the forces against the Destruction under the IPC's blueprint... That's quite a clever move.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I suggest we proceed with caution. Even if we become the nominal "leaders," it won't be easy for us to outmaneuver the IPC.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what do you think?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Your misgivings are valid. The Express has its own path to follow. It's not the right time to be getting involved in political games.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To fight the Destruction, we need more allies.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You're right. The more friends, the better. But I'm worried that the cost of this friendship will be our "freedom."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The IPC's invitation? We've gotta think this through carefully.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Black Swan has left.
What do you think, Pom-Pom?
You explained to March 7th why Black Swan left.
The conductor will respect every Nameless's choice. However...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Since setting sail again, Pom-Pom's seen many once-neutral worlds become IPC territory.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Better be careful with Jade's invitation.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The discussion's over, so let's take a vote. I reserve my judgment on this.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I feel the same way.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Black Swan has left.
You explained to Dan Heng why the Black Swan left.
I second that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Me too.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I abstain.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Black Swan has left.
You explained to Sunday why Black Swan left.
After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we cannot accept your proposal for the moment.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I don't suppose Mr. Sunday put in a good word for me, did he?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: You told everyone about Black Swan's departure.
As you can see, the Astral Express has made its choice.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But somehow you don't seem surprised?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Change takes time, I understand. As Miss Himeko said, it's just "for the moment."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: There's no need to give me an immediate answer. Patience is one of my strengths.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: After leaving Amphoreus, the Express will seek out a developed world to restock our supplies.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: When that time comes, our allies from the Strategic Investment Department are welcome to visit us aboard the Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Perhaps it's the familiar comfort of returning to an old haunt, or the buoyant air suffused with joy... whatever the reason, the conductor seems to be in high spirits.
In that case, I have another proposal. One that might be more... familiar to Miss Himeko...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I hear the moon of Planarcadia is full again.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I bet Miss Himeko would love to go home and see it, wouldn't you?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: So the moon is full once again. I wonder if all is well over there?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stable and prosperous, as usual. Planarcadia has long since become one of the IPC's most valuable planetary assets.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Although I cannot visit there in person, if the Express passes through Planarcadia, my colleagues will surely give you a grand...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Welcoming ceremony.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: That's very thoughtful of you. We'll give it serious consideration.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Sorry for taking up so much of your time. I should get going now.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Remember, the gates of Astropolis will always be open to the Astral Express. May the winds be favorable on your Trailblazing expedition.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: "Planarcadia"...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's been fifteen years since I last heard that name.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's clear she came prepared. Astropolis was probably just a cover. Jade's real objective was to let us know about the IPC's movements in my homeland.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Are you planning to go back and check it out?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Why don't we first explain things to these confused kids?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The civilization of Planarcadia on Ahatopia is my homeland, and it's also where the Astral Express once crashed and set off again.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's rare to hear you talk about your homeland...
Well, I've been away for so long.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To be honest, I'm also not quite sure about this.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Dan Heng, March 7th, and [Trailblazer]... You've all grown so much during your time in Amphoreus. Each of you has become a truly capable Nameless.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So you must understand that Jade was right. The Trailblaze no longer means what it once did for the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Do we keep wandering through space? Or, as she suggested, do we become a core force against the Destruction?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We should give this question some serious thought before we depart. Going back to where the Trailblaze began again could be a way to reconnect with our original purpose.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: More importantly, our last stop was really exhausting, so we need to take a proper break. Ahatopia is an arcadian world steeped in the Elation, making it the perfect vacation spot.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So, what do you think? That's my suggestion. Give it some thought.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh right, Black Swan wasn't part of our discussion earlier. [Trailblazer], would you mind passing the message on to her?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ahatopia... That's an ancient world, if I remember correctly.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are you familiar with the place?

"Ahatopia is located in the Consternation Starzone. It is said that in the distant past, the Aeon of Elation, Aha, once stopped here, turning it into a stage for the Masked Fools and Mourning Actors, and drawing travelers from many worlds."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "After the Destruction came into being, this place too was driven to the brink by the Legion's onslaught. Many ancient nations vanished, and the entire world sank into a painted world upon canvas."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Fortunately, with support from the Interastral Peace Corporation's 'Worlds Reborn Initiative,' Planarcadia emerged from the planar realm, regained its former vitality, joined the pan-cosmic trade network, and became one of the IPC's key assets and markets."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "As of today, an array of local entertainment creations originating from Planarcadia has circulated far and wide across the cosmos..."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What, the IPC again?
This information is pulled from the IPC's open-source data bank, for reference only.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: After leaving the Xianzhou, I spent some time with the IPC fleet, where I met a Fool from this arcadia.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Aeon of Elation... can cry?
A world blessed by Aha?
Hard to imagine, right? I can't wrap my head around it either. But the Fools' tales have always been absurd.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hard to imagine, right? In a world blessed by the Elation, even the moon wears a smile. The Fools' tales have always been absurd.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Seeing is believing. The best way to understand this peculiar world is to visit it ourselves.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Have you noticed how Himeko gets lost in thought whenever we talk about her homeland?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So, I snuck a peek at the navigation log and found...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Isn't the Express log already available for everyone to see?
Why are you sneaking peeks?
Care to elaborate?
Oh come on, you're missing the point here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Because sneaking peeks makes it way more thrilling!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Better say no.
I'm okay with it.
I found an unfamiliar signature in the logs, something like "Mura..." Based on the timeline, it must be someone Himeko knew.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But she's never mentioned it. I bet there's some big secret behind all this.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When discussing the Alliance, Madam Jade only mentioned the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Perhaps the "Anti-Destruction Alliance" is just the Ten Stonehearts' one-sided initiative.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Don't they represent the IPC?
Better say no.
The IPC is full of competing camps. If I'm not mistaken, all the factions on that list are forces that Diamond is trying to win over.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I'm okay with it.
The Strategic Investment Department needs enough leverage to silence their opposition within the IPC.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Some olive branch.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Sorry, but I'm afraid my journey with the Express... has come to an end.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Of course not! The time I've spent with all of you is a treasure I couldn't find anywhere else.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If the Astral Express ever needs a Memokeeper, I'll be glad to help.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: When you miss me, gently call out to me in your thoughts. If needed... the "lady" slumbering within March 7th knows how to find me.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Planarcadia, another land known as an "arcadia"...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Clearly, the fall of Irontomb has sent shockwaves across the universe. Even the usually scattered Memokeepers have received a call to gather.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Trust the lady. She's no stranger to dancing on a knife's edge, and she's always made it out in one piece.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: [Trailblazer], still thinking about the next stop?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is that so? If she chose to leave on her own, she must have good reasons for doing so.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I hope the Garden of Recollection has no way of knowing what happened inside Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I trust everyone's judgment.
I wonder what interesting sights await us in Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What? She just left like that? Without even saying goodbye? I was thinking of throwing her a proper farewell party!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Black Swan went against the laws of the Garden of Recollection to help us. I wonder if the Memokeepers will give her a hard time at this gathering...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wish her all the best.
She'll surely ask for help if she needs it.
Yeah, pathstriders of Remembrance are all really resourceful. I hope her path ahead is smooth.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Without Black Swan, the Express would have never made it to Amphoreus, let alone experience this unprecedented adventure.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Instead of treating this as a goodbye, why not cherish these memories and look forward to the day we meet again?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Let the conductor sound a whistle for her and wish her smooth sailing ahead!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Since we're all in agreement, conductor, prepare for the warp jump.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I dreamed it again...
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: ...What a ridiculous dream, even more over-the-top than what that guy promised.
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: Looks like the Express has once again taken the wrong route.
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: But there's nothing we can do about it... In the river of time, if cause and effect can be kept apart for long, they're bound to have a terrifying reunion.
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: Am I right, observer... watching us from behind countless veils?
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: I've been rambling on since the show just started... You must be totally lost, aren't you? Then just forget all that nonsense I was spouting.
rows.speaker: Awakening Girl

rows.text: So we're not just stopping in low orbit this time, but making a direct landing?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: According to the comms, the officials have prepared a dedicated platform for the Astral Express to dock.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: A whole platform? Just for us? Is this some kind of VIP treatment for coming home? Talk about rolling out the red carpet!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Express has arrived at the station. Connecting to local communications...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: From what I see, the Astral Express is considered a legend across the cosmos, so preparing a fitting gift would be more than appropriate.
I want to join the negotiations too.
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Pearl from the IPC's Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Now, in my capacity as the legal representative and CEO of this arcadia, I welcome the Express Navigator, Miss Himeko, back home.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Hello, Miss Pearl. This is news to me. I wasn't aware that the Strategic Investment Department had taken over administration of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As its governing official, I am still in the process of learning. If I can help this planet grow more prosperous, it would be a profound honor.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We would be even more honored to have a face-to-face conversation with you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's exactly what I wanted to say: While the Express is stationed here, the IPC will reasonably accommodate all your requests, including the one you just mentioned.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Pardon my choice of words, but I sincerely hope that you enjoy your time in Planarcadia so much you never want to leave.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In that case, I'd like to know about recent events in this world. I heard from Madam Jade that it's once again the time of the full moon?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Indeed. I believe it's also welcoming the Express.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: After fifteen years, now that the Phantasmoon of Elation is full again, the Phantasmoon Games will begin as scheduled.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The more lively, the better! During these divine games, distinguished guests from across the cosmos will be stopping by.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This time, along with the Express, a delegate from the Xianzhou Alliance has also arrived. Don't be surprised if you happen to run into them.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: A Xianzhou envoy?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's right. A big shot from the Yuque.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Since you've just arrived, I won't keep you any longer. I've arranged for staff to wait for you at the platform. Feel free to ask them for anything you need.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: All of this is a token of appreciation from the Strategic Investment Department to our friends. We hope you'll enjoy yourselves to the fullest.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Madam Pearl's style... is different from Aventurine's, but her methods are cut from the same cloth.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Straight to the point, clean and decisive. It's obvious that "the Express not going to Astropolis" was part of their plan all along.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This could go on forever. They're really pulling out all the stops to form this "Anti-Destruction Alliance."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Looks like we need to pay them a visit, whether to understand the CEO's intentions or to firmly reject their proposal.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: At least in my homeland, we have more room to maneuver. Welt, care to join me?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Looks like we don't get a vacation after all.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: As for everyone else, you're free to do as you please. My suggestion is: Why not take a look around and get to know this world better?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I appreciate your enthusiasm, really. But I have something else I'd like you to help me with.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: In that case, Sunday and I will go gather some intel about the Xianzhou envoy.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Huh? Why you two?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I asked Dan Heng to bring me along.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I can't appear in public given my identity. But I have a feeling that the Express might need to make some tough decisions in these complicated circumstances.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Understanding the Xianzhou Alliance's stance might help us on our journey.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you had the toughest time in Amphoreus. Since we're splitting up, why not make your mission "take a break with March"?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm saying this from the bottom of my heart: I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Same goes for you, March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ugh, now we'll look like two immature kids just loafing around.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm already a grown-up.
I'm still just a kid.
Wow, you grew up pretty fast then!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pretty proud of yourself, huh?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, you two. Just make sure to come see me in the Parlor Car before you leave.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I have a favor to ask of you both.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I've made contact with the Xianzhou delegation. Sunday, let's head out.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If there is any etiquette I need to follow when meeting Xianzhou people, please let me know in advance.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You two saw that special moon in the sky, didn't you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not really. As far as I know, many factions have their own ways of gaining an audience with THEM.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Aha the Elation. Legend has it that THEY personally started the Phantasmoon Games, though THEIR motives remain a subject of much speculation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: According to historical records, when a Supplicant rises above the rest, the Elation will manifest, listen to the victor's wishes, and share THEIR authority... for one minute.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The first signs of the war among the Aeons are beginning to show. I believe this is why the IPC has been positioning itself here for years.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Me too! I won't let [Trailblazer] walk ahead alone.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That puzzles me too. The winner gets to share an Aeon's authority. This can't be just a simple game, can it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Stop acting all cool! If you don't have any thoughts about the games, I'm gonna act on my own!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I see you already have your own thoughts on this. In that case, everyone's got a mission to take care of now.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ready to head out? Have fun out there.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I heard there are giant mechs all over Planarcadia. I'm quite jealous you'll get to see them in person.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Isn't Miss Pearl, who we're going to meet, an Intellitron herself?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You don't get it. There's a huge difference between a "robot" and a "GIANT robot."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hmm hmm~ ♬
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Come on, you two. Follow my lead and let's dive into the Interplanar...
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: JUMP!
I need a moment to get ready.
Gray Hair, getting cold feet? Just dive right in!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: In the name of Erudition, traverse the cosmos.
Mr. Yang is a grown-up.
Mr. Yang would be glad to hear that.
Mechatrons... aren't exactly toys, are they?
We meet again, Deliverer from beyond the sky.
I am not the Theoros you know, but the Masked Fool, Zandar Two Kuwabara.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"?

rows.text: This time, I choose to walk the path of Elation, and I shall defeat Nous with my sense of humor.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"?

rows.text: Hah, after all, I did say before...
rows.speaker: "Zandar"?

rows.text: Hey Gray Hair, wanna play a round of Cosmicon Collective with me?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Alright, let's do this!
Nah, I've got better stuff to do.
Hmm? What else do you have to do, Gray Hair?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: My latest dream is to join the Genius Society and play the role of a genius!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Hey there, Gray Hair and darling March!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Wait around with them...
I have other things to do...
Sparkle!? Ugh, it was you all along...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Surprised? Well, this time I'm here as Planarcadia's cultural advisor, specially appointed to be the tour director for the Express crew.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: What are you talking about? I am your director. Director Sparkle.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Let's play Cosmicon Collective!
Nothing.
Since it's your order, I'll humbly obey. But hey, don't go tattling later, saying I'm slacking off on my duties.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: What are you talking about? This is the world of Elation. Fools are everywhere. Don't even think about doing business here without us.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Bingo! Miss Sparkle is planning to toy with both of your destinies as if they're just her playthings. Scared yet?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Holy cow, it's packed in here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Correct! Ten points for the Astral Express!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: I know we had some minor entanglements in Penacony, but you all had fun there, didn't you?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Now, the Astral Express has become quite the hero. Her Excellency the CEO wanted to find someone who got along with you to show you around this place. So I took on that job!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: What kind of misunderstanding does she have about the phrase "got along"...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Time's ticking away! Thankfully there's no bomb here! So, are you coming with me or what?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Fine. But from now on, no more pretending to be someone else!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Whoa...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is this... a train? Looking sharp!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thanks for the compliment!
The train just spoke!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Before us stands not just a train, but a strangeling.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: The term strangeling is so outdated!
Times have changed, dear guests. Please refer to the Faekind Protection Act. We prefer to be called imagenae.
Ugh, so by-the-book. You really love those fancy scientific names from the IPC textbooks, huh? Fine, have it your way...
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: This here is a species unique to Planarcadia: an imagenae, or a being born from paintings.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Pretty sharp, aren't you? You caught on quick.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Once upon a time, the artists here discovered that by sketching creatures from their imagination and giving them names, they could bring their creations into reality.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: This belief in things yet to exist is called "Wishpower," and it sustains the existence of imagenae. If you ask me, this power must be a blessing from The Laughter!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Oops, got sidetracked! This here is the "Bullet Wyrm Express," an imagenae in charge of transportation. You could say they're in the same line of work as you folks.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Hahaha, so you two must be the Nameless from the Astral Express? The passengers in my stomach are always gossiping about you!
rows.speaker: Bullet Wyrm Express

rows.text: Why don't you take a guess?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Gray Hair, care to play cards with me? Think of it as a rehearsal for the Phantasmoon Games, right here at this tiny card table.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: A streamer who's about to go live at the plaza. She calls herself "Sparxie."
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: That's right. She's your enemy. This streamer, just like you, has been seeking a chance to join the Phantasmoon Games... It won't be long before she shows up at the plaza.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Hmm, I'm starting to question his judgment in picking people.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What's with that Intellitron lady's weird take on "getting along" anyway?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's drop by when we get a chance.
Sparkle is way more lovable than this one here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I knew it! You don't want to see my despicable face! I, Skott, totally understand your frustration! As long as you're safe and sound, that's all I care about.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Enemy!? Not on my watch! Anyone who wants to harm my esteemed bosses will have to first step over my dead body!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Uh... that's not really appropriate, is it? Not that I'm refusing your request. I can play too. I mean, I'm quite a card player myself.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: The annoying guy is finally gone. Let's head into the plaza and see what fun stuff they've got.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What can I do for you, boss?
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: I'll be like a shadow, standing by and awaiting your orders.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: You don't understand anything about the love between me and Sparxicle!
rows.speaker: Obsessed Fan

rows.text: I must nip this twisted love of yours in the bud!
rows.speaker: Calm Fan

rows.text: I know you! You're that... the one from the news... Ah right! The Famous of the Cosmic Express!
rows.speaker: Fanatical Fan

rows.text: If you ever want to practice, come find me anytime.
rows.speaker: Loftin

rows.text: Huh?
rows.speaker: Idle Citizen

rows.text: Well, you came to the right wispae. Look around! We've got a three-in-one world game collection. Which one catches your eye?
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: Then go ahead and fall.
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: Keep flapping, don't drop outta the sky now!
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: Oh right, there are other players around this plaza. If you're still up for more, feel free to chat with them.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: As expected of the Nameless, our great hero! Your card skills are truly remarkable!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: But I lost, didn't I?
Grab some more, don't hold back.
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: What is it?
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: I'm Oris.
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: "The Wispae That Constantly Falls," "The Wispae That Wants To Fly But Can't Fly," and "The Wispae Waiting For Money to Fall From The Sky" — mainly these three fashionable items.
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: ...Just like there are upbeat wispae, there are bound to be these gloomy ones too. Hope you'll like them.
rows.speaker: Oris

rows.text: Oh? There's someone who doesn't know the great Lady Sparxie? I smell a new fan in the making!
rows.speaker: Enthusiastic Fan

rows.text: The livestream... should be starting soon, right?
rows.speaker: Enthusiastic Fan

rows.text: You'll have to see how adorable Lady Sparxie looks when she makes her entrance!
rows.speaker: Enthusiastic Fan

rows.text: Ah, so my little pets managed to escape from their electronic cage. Looks like I'll have to use the "power of love" to catch you and bring you back.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: My dear lovely fans, those two bullies want to hurt me! Please, everyone, protect your beloved Sparxicle, won't you!?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Get those baddies! Get those baddies! Get those baddies!
rows.speaker: Fans

rows.text: Hey hey, we mean no harm! Can't we just talk this out?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ha! "No harm," "talk this out"? Isn't that exactly what the IPC loved to say when they took over Planarcadia? You're all cut from the same cloth!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You want to control the game that The Laughter left for this world, just like the IPC, don't you?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The ceremony left by the {RUBY_B#Aha}Master of Elation{RUBY_E#} must not be defiled by the likes of you, and turned into some boring, pathetic, dull, tedious, profit-driven... social mixer.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You've got us all wrong!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bringing the fun back to the Phantasmoon Games, that's the Masked Fools' unequivocal duty.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: My dearest, cutest fans~♥ Let's get this party started!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Stand down! Everyone! Don't move a muscle! Imaginae, you're under arrest for breaking the law!
Passengers of the Astral Express, I'm an officer from the Department of Aberration Defense. Don't worry, she won't be able to harm you as long as I'm here.
You meddlesome fool, officials have no right to interfere with a Supplicant's actions during the Phantasmoon Games, do they?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Only those who possess a mask can be called Supplicants. You're just one of thousands of troublemakers in this land who claim to be "joining the Phantasmoon Games" while actually causing chaos.
Planarcadia is a society governed by law. Any act that violates the law, even if done in the name of the Phantasmoon Games, will be severely punished by the Department of Aberration Defense.
Severely punished? Haha, you're just a lapdog of the IPC, yet you're still so full of pride. That's very funny.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That's exactly what I'm saying. Planarcadia under the IPC's rule is boring as hell~ Even the Phantasmoon Games have turned into some kiddie play-date for all the goody-two-shoes.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Nameless, you're free to go for now. But I'll be keeping my eyes on you.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Next time we meet, I'll turn you into devoted fans. I'll make you... mine~♥
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Hmph... escaped, huh?
So, who sent you to rescue us?
Excuse me, I'd like to have a word with you two.
Woof, hello! We're making sure Sparxie's fans leave in an orderly fashion, so please stay away from the plaza for now.
rows.speaker: Security Woofae

rows.text: Thank goodness we made it in time. Otherwise, things could've turned out pretty badly.
Isn't she in a meeting right now?
Don't worry, March and I don't get hurt that easily.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: By saying things could've turned out pretty badly, I meant you and Miss March knocking out all of her fans.
Let me introduce myself again. I'm Kuchiba, an officer from the Department of Aberration Defense.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: We don't need to introduce ourselves, do we? Miss Kuchiba, you probably know who we are.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course. The newspapers, TV channels... they've all been reporting on you non-stop.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Police dog? Oh, you mean those "woofae." They're legitimate law enforcement officers, and some of them have even more experience than I do.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: However, as a staff member of the Department of Aberration Defense, I have some special privileges that allow me to request their assistance.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Mm-hmm. As you both know, Planarcadia is quite a fascinating world. Creatures made real by artists' brushstrokes, objects that unexpectedly come to life, strange dimensions hidden within paintings, and even the ground beneath our feet that occasionally trembles...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: This is what the Department of Aberration Defense exists for: everything from managing supernatural anomalies to registering imagenae and ensuring their continued existence.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: And of course, there's the Phantasmoon Games that Sparxie just mentioned.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: If I'm not mistaken, was it Mr. Skott who sent you here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So that's the name of that high and mighty IPC Specialist. This... Mr. Skott believed he wasn't dealing with ordinary criminals, but with Masked Fools, which required decisive action. So a phone call was immediately made to the Department of Aberration Defense.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Well, it's not surprising... but what do we do now? Our guide ran off, and we got into a fight with Sparxie's fans... I guess our shopping plans for today are down the drain?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Should we give Himeko a call and fill her in on what's going on?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I guess you're right.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No need to rush, you two. Oh! I bet you haven't tried the local delicacies yet, have you?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: How about this? I'll take you both to grab a bite nearby. That way you can kill some time while waiting for your friend.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Yay! My stomach's been growling like crazy!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not long ago, somewhere in Duomension City...
Color reproduction: 96.2%. Brushstroke reproduction: 93.6%. Conclusion: On the physical level, my reproduction has reached the appraisal threshold.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This forgery can now be considered the authentic piece.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Yet you still seem dissatisfied.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Tell me, what troubles you? Is it that less than 4% margin of error? Or something beyond the numbers?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I'm grappling with a quality that defies measurement: artistry. It is the prerequisite for becoming the steward of this arcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But you already are its steward. "Diamond" will remember that you only took six months to claim that title.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It was five months and fifteen days. Empty titles mean nothing. In Planarcadia, political influence carries limited weight.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: To add a stroke to this artwork, one must first understand art.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I know you. This is the conclusion, not the cause.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: The piece before you, "Worldbreaker Waves," is a relic from one of the civilizations in Ahatopia's history, the final work left behind by Graphia, the ancestral painter of ancient Benzaitengoku. Legend says she performed a miracle, conjuring an entire plane of existence and sealing the whole world within her scroll.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Do you want to know how she did it?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I will not deny it. People call her achievements a "miracle," meaning its true nature remains unknown. In other words, it is an unexplored market.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Understanding comes first, then investment. That is the natural order.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Perhaps this is why "Diamond" chose you. An Intellitron devoted to results and efficiency, cast into a realm sustained by imagination.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: The "Ten Stonehearts" await a metamorphosis. May you find your own "Pearl" in this strange and dazzling sea.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Thank you. But my mission is to oversee the progress of the Phantasmoon Games. Personal growth is not part of the task.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Jade, allow me to point this out: The Ten Stonehearts are ten independent decision-makers. Your attempts to bind people together will only prove counterproductive and bring needless loss.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As always, I follow the optimal choice: neutrality. That is also my answer to Obsidian.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: A flawless reply. Your cool logic is always captivating.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Lady Pearl, that Express Navigator has come to see you.
rows.speaker: Mia

rows.text: It seems we no longer have the leisure to speak of art.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: This is all I have to say. Tell Diamond I will fulfill my duty of strategic investment.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Send the guests in.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Both of you, please, come in.
rows.speaker: Mia

rows.text: Forgive the sudden visit, and thank you for receiving us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It is not sudden. In my deductions, "a visit from the Express Crew" was an optimal choice for achieving effective communication. I am glad: Everything is proceeding smoothly.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: To skip the formalities would be best. I imagine that, at your "core," you're already well aware of our purposes?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I know that you have come for the "Anti-Destruction Alliance"...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The probability of refusing the proposal stands at 91.2%. Can you tell me: Why?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Express Crew bore witness to the resolve of many factions during the battle of Irontomb. We do not oppose the vision of an "alliance," but the Trailblaze must remain independent.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: From our perspective, the IPC already has the "Marketing Development Department," and every world it drew into the cosmic trade map eventually became a cornerstone for the Preservation.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That is a reasonable concern. Allow me to present data that is often overlooked. In the past two Eras, 1263 planets have joined the Pan-Cosmic Trade System, and 63% of them have preserved their native civilizations. This is the result of the Strategic Investment Department's work.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Planarcadia is one such world. On this land, the Preservation and the Elation co-exist in harmony.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That remains open to debate.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I recognize that throughout this "war against the Destruction," every participant may experience moments of doubt or retreat. But...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Based on extrapolations, we believe by following the route of the Trailblaze and building upon the framework of the Preservation, we shall gather the manpower of the Harmony, the computational strength of the Erudition, and the military might of the Hunt... The threat of the Destruction will ultimately be eliminated.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Hesitation breeds instability, and instability makes us vulnerable, and our enemies will exploit every crack to break us apart.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Your point is valid, but allow me to note one error. That number, 91.2%, is inaccurate.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Then, is the probability of rejection 100% in your eyes?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No, it is zero percent. Interestingly, the difference between "zero" and "one" is also only a matter of perspective.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We did not come to refuse the notion. On the contrary, the Astral Express seeks to work with you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This outcome... exceeds my extrapolations. Tell me, was it a change in emotion that led you both to shift your decision?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No. Actually, your earlier perspective inspired me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The IPC deals with powers that command billions of lives in this cosmic game of cards. The Express had always been insignificant compared to them.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We've simply been earnestly trailblazing and exploring all this time, trying to help worlds in crisis.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Now, it is this "earnestness" that has drawn many to journey with the Express, while the Nameless' simplicity assures our friends that they will not be consumed and lose their sense of self.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Indeed. If the Trailblaze has any outstanding strength, it is the track of "trust" that we walk.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That is why we came to you, Miss Pearl. Please set aside your role as one of the Ten Stonehearts and imagine this possibility...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To fight against the Destruction, there is no need for an alliance. What we need is to stand by each other.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The IPC may not stand as an ally of the Express, nor might the Strategic Investment Department... But "you" can.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Work with the Harmony, calculate alongside the Erudition, help aim the arrows of the Hunt, and build the steadfast shield of the Preservation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Then, what part does the Trailblaze wish to play in all this?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We shall become the sail.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The ship's sail? That sounds no different from my former proposal.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It is different. A sail that cuts through the storm does not care for its own welfare, nor does it try to command the ship's course.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But it will help all who wish to fight against the Destruction to traverse safely through the storm.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Interesting. Logic reminds me that those words you spoke are little more than rhetoric. However...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I will follow the optimal decision: neutrality.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You mentioned that the IPC has never changed Planarcadia, and it still follows the Path of Elation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But in my eyes, {RUBY_B#Ahatopia}Planarcadia{RUBY_E#} has not been altered because it still has value, just like the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The IPC intends to use the Phantasmoon Games to reach out to {RUBY_B#The Elation}an Aeon{RUBY_E#} and draw THEM in. Am I right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That involves classified information. I have no comments.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: However, since Miss Himeko is open to cooperation, I can share more within reasonable limits.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This way, guests.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Where's this...?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: A place in the World in Canvas, called the "Phantasmoon Courtyard."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This ancient tree is breathtaking.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This ancient tree has stood for a thousand years, blooming only on the eve of the games.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: According to ancient texts, this is the heart of the "Phantasmoon Games" ceremony.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Eight masks. Eight Supplicants. When people don the ancient masks in the near future, the altar will also reveal the masks' forms. Then, the games shall begin.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I've been told, Miss Himeko, that Graphia's blood courses through your veins...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The messenger of the Hunt is here as well at this moment. This Ceremony to compete for the Elation is but a reflection of cosmic politics.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In that case, why not use the result of the Phantasmoon Games to decide whether the Express will become a "sail" or a "banner"?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We'll consider your proposal.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: However, to take part in the games, one must have a "Mask of Elation." I assume the IPC has prepared for that.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As of now, the number of masks I possess is: three. With more time, I could obtain even more.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In all of history, no one has conceived of a unified command of all Supplicants and masks, let alone accomplished that feat.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But this time, the IPC intends to "regulate" the games with our resources and influence.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It is not unusual for visitors from beyond the sky to join the Phantasmoon Games, but the IPC... actually seeks to control the entire thing?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Aeon of Elation is famed for unpredictability. Miss Pearl, you must take care. This is a word of caution.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It is precisely because Aha is so mercurial that such an "elated" attempt has a chance to succeed.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Pardon the interruption, Madam Pearl.
rows.speaker: Mia

rows.text: The guide you dispatched has sent word. The Masked Fools have stirred up trouble, attacking him and the Express guests. They were separated in the chaos.
rows.speaker: Mia

rows.text: That is not surprising. Those Masked Fools have long kept the IPC in their sights.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It seems the Phantasmoon Games have begun, regardless of the Express's choice.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I'll get in touch with those two kids.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Miss Pearl, Welt and I must take our leave now for the sake of security.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Are you both leaving already? I had another plan in mind: to speak with Miss Himeko about the art history of ancient Benzaitengoku...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Especially your ancestor's final work Worldbreaker Waves and her unparalleled mastery of imagenesis art.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The three of them returned to the reception room.
Since Miss Pearl is in such high spirits... Himeko, shall I depart first?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'm counting on you, Welt.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mr. Yang, please accept this gift before you leave.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No, you are too kind. The Express has no shortage of operational funds. I cannot accept this money.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You misunderstand. To offer the Nameless something so mundane would be far too discourteous. Please, open this case first and see for yourself.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Oh? This is...!
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This is... the movable Magico Mechatron model from Pearluxe Corp. It's not even been released to the market yet.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I am aware: Mr. Yang has an expert understanding of robotics. I chose this gift especially for you, and I hope it pleases you.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This truly is a most generous gift. Thank you for such an offering.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Time to get down to business. I'll be taking my leave.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Wow, this path to school, lined with falling blossoms... it's such a youthful feeling! Definitely worth a photo.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes, quite a few TV dramas have been filmed here.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I imagine it is perfect for those classic series where couples part ways or lovers miss their chance, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Exactly. Follow this road straight ahead for a while, and you will arrive at Graphia Academy.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: This is Graphia Academy. You can wait for your companions here.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Oh, and to prevent further surprises, I have already informed your guide of your situation.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Here is my contact info. If you encounter any problems during the Phantasmoon Games, you may reach me at any time.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Thank you so much, Miss Kuchiba! Sorry for the trouble!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We are here. Let's check in with Mr. Yang first and see where he is.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mr. Yang still hasn't replied?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Soon enough. Word is he is standing outside the dean's office right now as punishment.
rows.speaker: Gossipy Student

rows.text: You glance at the class schedule on the desk.
Shall we find a place with better reception? How about heading inside the school to take a look?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Masks? Our club has dozens, doesn't it? What kind of mask is the dean even looking for...
rows.speaker: Drama Society Member

rows.text: Who cares? If Dean Sparxie wants them, we will find every last one and present them to her!
rows.speaker: Dean's Devoted Fan

rows.text: Look! There is the gray-haired hater. Grab {M#him!}{F#her!} For the sake of Sparxicle!
rows.speaker: Sparxie's Fan

rows.text: You rushed into the archives room and locked the door behind you.
Around the tranquil pond beneath the sacred tree, eight altars stand facing one another, seemingly arranged in an ancient ceremonial formation.
Beneath the empty pedestal, there's a barely legible inscription: "Incinerate all Wishes, subdue every evil."
You just want to wander around in there, don't you?
Really? Is it about the Phantasmoon Games?
rows.speaker: Spirited Student

rows.text: I have no idea. But if she decides to take part in the games, she's definitely gonna win!
rows.speaker: Excited Student

rows.text: No way. I was just thinking... isn't this big sis Himeko's alma mater?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This school lobby... It looks exactly like what I've seen in animations!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Too bad neither of us ever went to a real school. If only we could taste a bit of campus life here...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey [Trailblazer], how about we sneak in and pretend to be students?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, since we can't contact Mr. Yang yet, why don't we stroll around and keep an eye out for him? Maybe he's already here somewhere.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], come here! Quick! Look at this wave! It's so spectacular!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It won't suddenly come crashing down and drench us, will it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: See that? [Trailblazer] and {F#her}{M#his} arch-nemesis are at it again.
rows.speaker: Curious Student

rows.text: Wait, this is painted too? The painter's name is even stated next to it. Graphia... Who's that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: T—Transfer procedures? What's going on here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go take a look, shall we?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I heard Sparxicle is planning to make a huge announcement later!
rows.speaker: Excited Student

rows.text: Lady Sparxie is the cutest girl in the world. Who could possibly stand a chance against someone as cute as her!?
rows.speaker: Spirited Student

rows.text: That's so true!
rows.speaker: Excited Student

rows.text: Wow... it seems this Sparxie really is a celebrity.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's a reflection of the moon in the water... but you can't even see the moon from here.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I heard Skott got into another clash with a teacher...
rows.speaker: Gossipy Student

rows.text: That blond-haired delinquent from third year? Hah, no surprise there. Which teacher did he annoy this time?
rows.speaker: Calm Student

rows.text: No idea, but it looks like he is about to be expelled. He should have been kicked out long ago, if you ask me. He struts around as if he owns the place just because his dad works for the IPC.
rows.speaker: Gossipy Student

rows.text: Just expel that scumbag already!
rows.speaker: Calm Student

rows.text: Hey, did you see that? A tall guy with brown hair and glasses just walked by. Who's he?
rows.speaker: Curious Student

rows.text: I heard he's a new teacher.
rows.speaker: Idle Student

rows.text: He is so handsome~ Sure, he looks a bit older, but that mature charm is exactly what makes my heart race.
rows.speaker: Curious Student

rows.text: Haha, don't be silly. You are not planning to hand the teacher a love letter, are you?
rows.speaker: Idle Student

rows.text: Brown hair, glasses, tall... why does that sound like Mr. Yang?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? No way. Is Mr. Yang really that lovable... haha?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer]! Wh—What the heck! Why's Skott here!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What year are you two in? Seeing your senior and not even bowing? How rude!
rows.speaker: Scott, Under Time-Out

rows.text: Wait. You... why do you two look so familiar? It feels like someone sent me here to find you...
rows.speaker: Scott, Under Time-Out

rows.text: Oh, please! We only spent a few days at Paperfold University. Where did you even buy that diploma?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Relax. With the way we look, we fit right in among the students.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now I know it's definitely the real Skott. [Trailblazer], where did we get teleported to?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A high school drama?
A school robot animation?
This is obviously a nightmare. Wake up!
I don't wanna go to the same school with someone like that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: An animation where fourteen-year-olds are trained to pilot giant robots and fight mysterious alien creatures? We're way past that age, aren't we!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course. As of this moment, I have taken over this school and become its acting dean!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Stop sleeping! Your fleeting youth is slipping away!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ouch! Pinch your own cheeks, not mine! This is real! Not a dream!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Artist Qualification Exam is right around the corner, and some students are still dozing off in class!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Silence! How dare you call the dean by name? Do you have no respect for her at all?
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Skott, it has been two years since that baseball club incident. Are you still holding a grudge against {M#him?}{F#her?}
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who's making such a racket at the door?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: If apologies solved everything, why would we need cops? I know what you are: a devil with a twisted, antisocial heart.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Mr. Yang! You're here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Students, what are you doing in front of the door?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That was Skott...! Where did he go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I just finished your transfer procedures and am waiting for the dean's confirmation. Whatever it is, let's discuss it inside.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What's this transfer business all about?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, starting from today, you two are officially transferring to this academy to begin your brand-new school life.
Sparxie!?!?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer] & March 7th

rows.text: Yo-ho~ My good classmates, we meet again!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What are you doing here!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What news on the net could possibly escape the all-knowing digital fairy Sparxicle?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Ah, you're here, Dean.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You? You're the dean!?
After all, this school is filled with fans who watch my streams. A little "cognitive adjustment" is all it takes to make plenty of them do whatever I want.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Huh? Why the hostile stares? Surely you're not thinking of roughing up the "dean"?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Oh noooo!!!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer] & March 7th

rows.text: You've never been more grateful for your gray hair. In this concrete jungle, you've got natural camouflage. You, [Trailblazer], were born to be a master of stealth.
You're ecstatic, holding your breath, with your inner gossip-monger burning in your chest. You're as happy as a raccoon that's just spotted a trashcan within reach.
...Wake up!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wake up! The teacher's here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You kick over the bucket beside you and walk out from the corner.
Idiot... the dean has had their eyes on you for ages!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph, [Trailblazer], if not for Miss Sparxie, I would have beaten you to a pulp right now.
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: You called March 7th over and showed her the card.
What did I do to you this time?
...What do you mean "that's it"? Were you planning something even worse for me!?
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Just last week, when I was about to confess my feelings, you folded my love letter into a paper airplane and sent it flying into the toilet!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: And when I tried to fish it out... the girls in class completely misunderstood me!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Listen up, [Trailblazer]! I'm here to challenge you to a duel! After school today, I will be waiting on the rooftop. Do you dare to come!?
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: It's a deal. Do not even think of running away.
You two, out of my way. I'm done with class!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Swapping avatars is as easy as slipping on a shirt for a streamer. Most people only care about appearances anyways. Isn't that right, Nameless?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: School... students? What in the world is going on here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah, what a shame... Dan Heng's gone after all...
rows.speaker: Sad Student

rows.text: Whoa, easy there. He got transferred.
rows.speaker: Bored Student

rows.text: I didn't even get the chance to confess my feelings...
rows.speaker: Sad Student

rows.text: Outside the door, hurried and chaotic footsteps gradually approached.
With ears that sway like the feeble willows in a gentle breeze, and half-lidded eyes like autumn waters ready to slumber...
Word is he chose to transfer 'cause he got so swamped with so many love letters he just couldn't deal with them anymore.
rows.speaker: Bored Student

rows.text: Probably about the Baseball Club, right?
rows.speaker: Gossipy Student

rows.text: Who knows? Maybe they're romantic rivals or something... I heard Skott's got his eye on someone lately.
rows.speaker: Curious Student

rows.text: I know! You're talking about Rakshmi from the class next door!
rows.speaker: Gossipy Student

rows.text: She has always been our dean, hasn't she?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You stumped me there... At our age, what else could we be but students here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's me!!!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Look, the dean is in the photo too, and so is Mr. Yang, our homeroom and history teacher.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah... I think that's right?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's simple. Check the schedule, and when the next class begins, make sure you listen closely.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can see it in your eyes, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Raccoon. You will not accept defeat.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Better not! Getting expelled right before graduation is no joke.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ... Why bring that up all of a sudden?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Dan Heng...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh. This teacher seems to have taken the day off. The dean has been looking for her, too.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Anyway, even though our time at school is running out, we still have the chance to do something now, don't we?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who exactly... was I supposed to find?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yeah! Waste your youth with me. If we don't waste it now, it'll be too late!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I have so many things I want to do. Where should I start?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Should I head to class, deal with Skott, or... just wander around?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Next class is... History? Should I go? Or check out another classroom instead?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Am I seeing things? Why is there another me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Skott said he wants to duel me on the rooftop.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Why not take the side path up and see if there's an ambush?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The protagonist? No wonder! You always feel like your life is full of incredible adventures. Everyone treats you differently, and you somehow manage to escape death every single time. You have this vague, indescribable feeling that you're important to this universe.
It's the first time someone's called you something so over the top. What's her angle? You can't help but feel suspicious.
This can't be the same Rakshmi Mr. Tail said was into Skott. Did she put on a few pounds or something?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Finally, the perfect chance. Come on, hurry and confess!)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Skott, weren't you the one who called me to the rooftop... for a duel?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's over... my campus romance... and the gang I built with my own hands. You ruined them all! Are you happy now!?
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: Quiet! I need to calm down! Y—You stay away from me!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: We found Mr. Yang in the dean's office, but Sparxie suddenly popped out! We were actually here to find Ms. Dollie!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, did the dean send you here? Seriously. Leaving us here to do all the work is just too much!
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: The signal is a bit weak here.
What did the teacher ask you to look for?
We were sent to find Ms. Dollie.
What's going on? Not paying attention in class is bad enough, but you don't even listen to the teacher's instructions?
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: Have you seen a mask with a smile on it? The teacher told us to find it.
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: I got my PhD from Paperfold University.
We're going to get kicked out, you know!
Seems like you still haven't had your fill of wandering around.
A... a mask? Now I remember. We came here to look for a mask.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What a coincidence! I'm here for the same thing. Get to work already!
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: Do you know which teacher is Ms. Dollie?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: On the imagenated painting, a small inscription explained its origin: With water drawn from Dovebrook, I effaced a mistaken stroke, yet unexpectedly, a flurry of waves emerged. Thus inspired, I seized my brush to capture this scene, as an ode to the exquisite forms of nature.
March 7th, [Trailblazer], your transfer procedures have been completed. Please proceed to the dean's office immediately.
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: How should I put this... She is such a unique woman. Super unique! Once you meet her, you will never forget what she looks like!
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: Woah! How beautiful is this Ms. Dollie?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? Beauty and Ms. Dollie have nothing to do with each other. If you have any group photos or faculty event pictures, I can point her out to you. But seriously, are you going to help me with this work or not?
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: March, didn't you show me a group photo earlier?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I have a class photo right here, but it only shows two teachers.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Seriously? There are three teachers in this photo.
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: Isn't Ms. Dollie right here?
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: Wait. That's Ms. Dollie?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She's a charm doll, probably the teacher who's worked the longest out of the entire staff. Wait, don't tell me you've never taken her imagenesis class?
rows.speaker: Rummaging Student

rows.text: I—I finally remember it... Himeko told us we must find Ms. Dollie and take the mask back from her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Two years...? Wait, even those two years were fake!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But all the pain of studying felt so real! That just makes Sparxie even more annoying!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait, why did you just call us "students"?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, what happened to your power of the Remembrance? How could you be led around so easily?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Two years of studying" were nothing but an illusion. At most, we've only been trapped here for two hours. It's not too late to act now.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now that we know what Ms. Dollie looks like, it is time for me to step up...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ms. Dollie has vanished. Either she's been captured, or she's actively hiding from Sparxie. All we need to do is find her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Even though Ms. Dollie is in hiding, we can still capture her lingering memories.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Follow the trail of these memosprites...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We're getting real close... There is a fragment of Ms. Dollie's memory here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I got a photo of her!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That Sparxie... she's not really the dean at all, is she?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie's Voice

rows.text: What are her intentions?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie's Voice

rows.text: Alright, alright, relax! How about forgetting the Phantasmoon Games for now?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Instead, throw yourselves into a carefree, cozy, romantic, and enthusiastic school life!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: She is searching for me. I must stay hidden...
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie's Voice

rows.text: Two years later...
Seal off the imagenesis classroom... can't let her find me!
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie's Voice

rows.text: Found it! Let's go! We have to get the mask before Sparxie does.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The girl's breath, gentle as a spring breeze, tickles both your ear tips and your heartstrings.
So I closed my eyes, and two years have already gone past?
March, watch out, it's Sparxie!

Before you stands an online streamer, a singer-songwriter, a trendsetter of internet culture, a rising star in education, and the Masked Fool among Masked Fools. Show some respect and address her as dean, thank you!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: It's fine, it's fine, Skott~♥ Thank you for standing up for the teacher~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Such strong willpower, [Trailblazer]. No wonder that {RUBY_B#Sparkle}outdated model{RUBY_E#} wanted you in the Phantasmoon Games. Too bad you crossed paths with me.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Soon, you will be just like these students. All of you will be turned into my little toys~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Students! Today is Campus Cleanup Day, so help dean Sparxie find "that thing"~♥ Search places like the archive room from top to bottom.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: And teachers are all required to pitch in as well. If anyone spots that truant teacher, be sure to tell me. I will reward obedient students handsomely!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Okay!
rows.speaker: Students

rows.text: The door to this classroom... it's locked, just as I thought.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Better look for another way in.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Easy for you to say! If it weren't for [Trailblazer], I would already have made my mark at the school sports meet! That jerk crushed my baseball dreams!
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: That's it?
Sorry, my nemesis.
A—Are you a student from Graphia Academy? I've already sealed this classroom... How did you find me?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: Ms. Dollie? Don't be afraid. Himeko sent me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That impostor dean outside is rummaging for it too, right?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: Alright, enough! Please, I'm begging you, {M#bro!}{F#ma'am!}
rows.speaker: Skott

rows.text: That's right. The Masked Fool Sparxie pulled off a takeover of the academy... It took me so much work to find you.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm sorry. I really had no idea...
Yet another rival has fallen by your hand, and now none remains on campus to challenge you. Standing atop the rooftop, you feel life's loneliness descend upon you, cold as snow.
Did Skott drop something? Is it equipment?
In the archive room, students were frantically rummaging through cabinets and drawers.
I'm one of the Nameless on the Astral Express, and right now I'm the only one who can protect you. Please, you must trust me!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Astral Express... indeed, I read about its arrival in Planarcadia in the papers and saw it on TV recently.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: Since you claim to be Himeko's friend, answer a few questions about her. If your answers are correct, I will entrust you with the mask.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: I'm ready for this. Fire away!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What kind of coffee is Himeko best at brewing...
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: W—Wait a second! How could you ask such a question? Don't you know her coffee is absolutely undrinkable?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ahahaha, looks like you've suffered from it yourself. Then here is the second question. What kind of people does Himeko hate the most?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: A real chatterbox with a silver tongue. Word is, she even managed to kick a Nameless off the Express because of that.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Very well, I can almost trust you. The final question: Himeko experienced the greatest regret of her life during her time at this school. What was that?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: Who knows? Could it be about... that time she got a stylish short haircut to keep up with the trends?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: S—She actually told you that story? It seems you really are her friend. But that's not the answer.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: ...Huh? Did I really get played by that guy?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It isn't that you were wrong. Perhaps Himeko never told you. Now that I think about it, she might never bring herself to share such a burden...
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: I believe you. You truly are Himeko's friend. Then...
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: What!? I actually let myself be fooled by such a cheap trick?
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: That {RUBY_B#Welt}man with glasses{RUBY_E#} seems to have no issues with "becoming a teacher." Once I took your forms and chatted with him, I got everything I wanted to know.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Darn it! That wretched Sparxie had us running in circles!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Two whole years wasted!
Hahaha! Sometimes trust among companions can be quite dangerous.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: It must be... it must be because I'm so passionate about learning! That's why I fell into the illusion so fast. Wait, [Trailblazer]... you didn't notice it either, did you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now you've done it! How dare you trick Mr. Yang!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March's serious mode, activate!
I'll show Sparxie how the power of the Remembrance should really be used! It'll just cost us some film.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You have really made me angry! She can't run away anyway, [Trailblazer], so why don't we take the mask from her by force!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Woo-hoo~ Congratulations! You found the missing link~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But the Mask of Elation that has been worn is like a clipped movie ticket. It only belongs to the one who used it first during the Phantasmoon Games... Seems you're completely unaware of such simple common sense. How sad~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Astral Express, out! The only one worthy of joining the games is the adorable Sparxicle!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Now then, it is time to treat my fans... You two will stay and witness my "SparxiCon" that I've carefully prepared, right~♥?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: SparxiCon?
Stop dreaming!
Give up. I will never hand over what she entrusted to me to outsiders.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: This will be a spectacle that shakes all of Planarcadia to its core, a grand performance unlike any before! It's brought to you by Sparxicle and live-streamed across the entire web!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You don't need to know the program list, because I will erase the last residues of resistance and hostility in your hearts and turn you into my loyal fans~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Oh my, how defiant! No wonder you are the toy favored by my {RUBY_B#Sparkle}old model{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: It's okay. I will erase the last residues of resistance and hostility in your hearts and turn you into my loyal fans~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: My dear fans, time to prepare! Carry off these two noisy haters for now. I have more important work to attend to.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Is this... the archive room?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey there, my sweetest fans, the mission of finding the mask and Ms. Dollie has been a complete success.
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: Everyone, let us drag that intruder out!
rows.speaker: Voice from Outside

rows.text: Yeah!!!
rows.speaker: Voice from Outside

rows.text: They will not be able to hide for long.
rows.speaker: Voice from Outside

rows.text: Haha. I may not know much about her time on the Express... but that does sound just like the bossy vibe she had back in school.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: Hiding won't save you! We will drag you out soon enough!
rows.speaker: Sparxie's Fan

rows.text: Have you reached the end of your rope?
(Look closely at the poster)
(This pink-haired person... where have I seen this person before?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is that right? No, no, that can't be... right...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The thing she regretted most... must be what happened fifteen years ago. No. Better not bring that up.
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: I remember now! She's the fox girl in the class photo!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So you actually managed to remember. Seems like this is what they call in comics... a "fateful encounter." You stumble into a bit of trouble, and I will happen to show up here.
You two came much too late!
rows.speaker: Ms. Dollie

rows.text: S—Sorry, Ms. Dollie! Darn it, Sparxie got ahead of us again! But how could she know so much about Himeko...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, come a little closer, will you?
What is this place...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Two Nameless came through here a few hours ago and asked the exact same question. I will use their answers to reply to you...
How dare you turn into me!
"This is a place in the World in Canvas, known as the Phantasmoon Courtyard. According to ancient texts, this is the heart of the 'Phantasmoon Games' ceremony."
Oh, and one of those Nameless is "playing" the part of a teacher at the school... Oh dear, was that a spoiler? That's not good.
Greetings, protagonist.
Greetings, Miss Fox.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just call me the Nameless.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Technically, everyone is the protagonist of their own story. But you are different... You are the protagonist of the Fluffy Across the Blue, aren't you?
Galactic... baseballer raccoon? Hm? You do not really look like a raccoon.
Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. You can call me Evanescia. Great seeing you!
Do not be afraid. Just think of me as part of the audience, like a reader following a comic.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Do not worry. I will lend {M#him}{F#her} a hand.
Darkness drapes over you like a canvas, and when it lifts, you find yourself somewhere else...
A bit of experience. Just like someone who has read enough comics can get superpowered battles and schoolyard romances without any instructions.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The dizziness from teleportation feels just like the weightlessness during Express warping, but what really makes your head spin is discovering that March 7th isn't by your side.
Looks like whoever tried to help could only barely manage to get you alone to safety.
Do you seriously mean you've never read it? The comic that has taken this world by storm?
rows.speaker: Evanescia
