rows.text: Looks like when it comes to top-tier VStreamer wars, the fanciest fights are fought the old-fashioned way!
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Man

rows.text: I... huh...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey, friends! Over here! Look this way!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is that... March's voice?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Over here! Mr. Yang and I are in the art classroom!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: While Sparkle keeps her busy, let's regroup with March first.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You look perfectly normal, though? So that "Professor" Welt [Trailblazer] saw in the news...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Who's the mask, and who's the master? That's still up for debate!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Love the Sparx, guard the Sparx~ Never fear the dark!
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Fan

rows.text: What kind of trash rhyming is that...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Miss Himeko! [Trailblazer]! You're finally here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You told March and Welt about the intel you obtained at the "tavern" and your action plan.
March, I'm just so happy you're safe, bana.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The students around here have been acting weirder and weirder... Good thing my heart is pure and untouched, so her tricks don't work on me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hold up, were you two just talking with some weird verbal tic?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We chose to fight poison with banana.
Is Mr. Yang okay?
...What? You actually used that Penaconian memetic virus to counter Sparxie's influence?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Before he was taken away, he managed to take a photo of the library. I want to check it out with [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Whether the Express turns into some crazy "Sparxie" train or ridiculous "monkey" train, I want neither!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March and I will go track down that furbo reporter. We might even find out where the last piece of the painting was hidden.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What about Welt? Is he alright?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mr. Yang, it's our friends! Come on out!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just a bit of acting on my part. Let's not dwell on that right now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Like March, I realized something was corrupting our cognition when I arrived at school. She even pulled from one of my past memories to strengthen the effect... It was pretty frustrating.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Luckily, I've dealt with something similar before... I snapped out of cognition corruption very fast this time, so I decided to keep playing the teacher and hide some students away in secret.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: So, any ideas on how to dispel Sparxie's influence?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...No wonder these students took down the seascape painting from the central courtyard. Sparxie had them break it into three parts: the waves, the wooden boat, and the moon.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I don't know where they hid the waves and the moon, but I managed to retrieve the "wooden boat" that was stored in the archive room from the students.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: As expected from "Teacher" Yang!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We might have a lead on the other two painting pieces. Have you seen... a furbo-nana?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You mean... a furbo?
rows.speaker: March 7th

(Peek through the door crack)
(Listen through the door crack)
In the classroom, someone carefully paced around, treading across the sticky floor... like a painter walking on spilled paint scattered all over the ground.
(Push the door with force)
But these students...
We sent a local reporter into the school, but his luck turned sour-nana. Sparxie caught him red-handed.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What about me and Mr. Yang? Now that we have a lead, no way we'll just sit here doing nothing!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's the plan. Let us know right away if you find any leads.

I know you have a lot of questions now... but we'll have time to talk about all this in detail after we deal with Sparxie.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko, where's the library?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I know the way... I just hope they haven't renovated the academy in the past fifteen years.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Give it up, you outdated model!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Shush! Eat my hammer!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Oww! Darn it!

rows.text: You didn't even finish the job.
What... in the world are all these things everywhere?
The Express Crew is here!

rows.text: Please follow my livestream channel!
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Student

rows.text: Please give Miss Sparxie lots of likes!
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Student

rows.text: A high-and-mighty Emoti is stuck fast in the basketball hoop. Perched there like a monarch upon a throne, it gazes down coldly at the frantic bustle of your efforts below.
You eyeballing me, emoti?
Let go! You're pulling my hair!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That's the whole point! Surrender to Miss Sparkle like a good girl!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: The library's just up ahead. Finally, I can get away from all these livestream-obsessed students...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We're here, bana.

rows.text: But I don't see any "waves" or "moon"...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Where could it be...? Like I'd ever tell you!
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Lady

rows.text: Miss Sparxie herself ordered us to guard this place with our lives.
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Man

rows.text: Hey, get that stream running...
rows.speaker: "Sparxified" Lady

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you better give that girl a taste of her own medicine for messing with us like some comedy act!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Kids these days... They ignore their studies just to focus on the internet.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As an alum of Graphia Academy, it's my duty, as tradition dictates, to give you all a proper "extracurricular lesson."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hey, juniors, ready to roll?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Where could they be hiding the landscape painting?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: After all, it's an image-nana'ed thing. Once sealed in a scroll or something, it'll be a pain to retrieve, bana...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh right, let's check out that photo-nana the reporter left us. Maybe we can find some clues?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Where are we now?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This place looks just like any other classroom... but something's off.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I think I heard someone laughing.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I didn't hear a thing.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Something's not right. Is there something hidden here?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Senior? You're back!
And you are...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But... how is this possible?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...We've got the "Wave" now. Time to regroup with Welt and the others.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You can't save them. They're already ghosts. It wasn't Sparxie who attacked them, but something far more cruel.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And they... didn't die in the present, but during a certain twilight, fifteen years ago. We can't change their fates.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: However, this definitely isn't some kind of time travel to the past...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Someone created this space for unknown reasons... only to re-enact before an eyewitness the bloodbath at Graphia Academy from the Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's right. But that has nothing to do with the enemy we're facing right now.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Come on. It's time for us to meet up with Welt. He just messaged and said he and March found the missing furbo nana reporter, bana, and the final landscape painting piece.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Get your fist outta my face!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Then move your foot first!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You okay, Mr. Furbo?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I saw everything! The Nameless from the Express smashed Sparxie right into the wall with one swing! That strength was unreal!
rows.speaker: Student

rows.text: Good thing we got here in time, or you would've ended up as a target practice dummy!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Beep boop, this furbo... nearly bit the dust!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: President, you're here! You're gonna give this furbo some hazard pay, right?
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: This Mr. Furbo said the students put the "moon" inside the gymnasium.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You retrace your steps back to that eerie twilight classroom.
Wispae called "emotis."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Sparxie must have given the moon to one of the emotis to look after!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: She really went all out, didn't she? The whole gym's full of moons... Now what!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Be it Sparkle or Sparxie, both are equally just as headache-inducing.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Alright, everyone, let's round up these emotis and take a look!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The texture of this ball... seems different from the others.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Okay, okay, don't cry. No one's going to hurt you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You! Fess up! Did you stash the moon somewhere!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I pried open its mouth to take a look. Seems this little guy didn't swallow the moon.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That sneaky laugh... it probably does know where the moon is hiding... but how are we meant to even reach the thing?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And with that, we've got our hands on the third part of the scenery, the "Moon".
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Alright! Time to settle the score with Sparxie!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: My bat's been itching for some action!
Since Sparxie dared to target the Astral Express, treating us like stepping-nana stones in the Phantasmoon Games, she had better be ready to become a spoil of war herself.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer] and I will head to the atrium next, piece the imagenated landscape painting back together, and help Sparkle take down Sparxie.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Welt, March, I'm counting on you to protect the students at the academy. Dovebrook's waves should suppress the memetic contamination they're experiencing, but they might panic and run into the combat area...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...This time, I truly hope no innocent people get hurt during the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Don't worry, Miss Himeko. Mr. Yang and I have got this.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What does everyone think? Will the Nameless win?
rows.speaker: Betting Student

rows.text: Let's cheer for Miss Sparxie!
rows.speaker: Betting Student

rows.text: Who will emerge victorious: Miss Sparxie or the Astral Express? Stay tuned to find out!
rows.speaker: Betting Student

rows.text: ...Are you okay, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Where did everyone go?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Look over here.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: General Yao Guang? Am I seeing things?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We're just "attuned" to each other, that's all.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Feeling dizzy? Don't worry. It's just a minor side effect.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: When I first "opened my eyes," I couldn't even conduct basic self-care for nearly a month. Don't worry, though. With my reinforcement, you'll be back to normal in a moment.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Thank you, general. By the way, above your head...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Words can deceive, but only "tuning" lays the truth bare.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Can you see the sign above my head?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: So, whether it brings weal or woe... whether it changes or not, please keep this secret safe for me. Don't let me know, and don't let anyone else, okay?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: What's in it for me?
Can't Sunday see your sign?
What are you afraid of?
Hey, I went out of my way to help you here. Can't you give me a discount? Consider it good karma!
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I'm afraid not. As an observer, your gaze reaches far deeper than his...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: In that fleeting moment, {RUBY_B#Stellaron's}your{RUBY_E#} eyes gained insight into my destiny...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: For those who wish to defy their own destiny, the best approach is to avoid gazing too long into fate, especially not letting {RUBY_B#you and I}powerful observers{RUBY_E#} do so.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Now that you know the reason, surely you'll do me this small favor and keep this secret?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: They say Aha once climbed to the highest bough of the Tree of Existence. Gazing out, THEY saw stars turning coldly like machines, and the meaning of everything yielded to nihility... Only the cry of a newborn made THEM burst into laughter.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I will keep this a secret.
But what if I let it slip?
Thanks. And of course, be careful not to let it slip, or else...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Heh heh, if you dare to spill the secret...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The universe and the gods set riddles for us, and we shall give THEM a surprise... An answer beyond the Finality.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I'll tell everyone all about your true identity! ...You're a "former Stellaron Hunter," aren't you?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Oh, just imagine the chain reaction that would cause! I don't even want to think about it!
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Doesn't this feel like the opening scene of a comedy? Two people who barely know each other, yet they're keeping each other's destiny a secret. Tsk, I guess you could say we're now "partners in fate," huh?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Could you be talking about... the school where Himeko and the others went?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No surprise there. After all, both "comedy" and "fortune-telling" thrive on unexpected twists and turns of fate, don't they?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I should've asked you to give them a few "secret strategies" before they left...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Alright, looks like the side effects have worn off. Time for us to say goodbye.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Yoohoooo! Welcome, dear guests! I've been waiting so long my phone's about to die!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you okay?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...What just happened?
rows.speaker: Student

rows.text: I was so confused. I couldn't see a thing. All I remember is Sparxie and the Nameless got into a fight.
rows.speaker: Student

rows.text: Th–That was such an epic fight... As expected from a cosmic hero, that was seriously awesome!
rows.speaker: Student

rows.text: Astral Express! Astral Express! Astral Express! Astral Express!
rows.speaker: Students

rows.text: Looks like the students have all recovered from the contamination.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Did they recover?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Who knows! But come on, doesn't that sound insanely cool?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: The tavern? Haha, they might kick up a fuss about Sparxie's defeat for a few days. Maybe some foolish hotheads might even come knocking to fight you...
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: If I really am a mask, then naturally I should return to my wearer's face.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Sparxie was totally outshone!
rows.speaker: Whispering Student

rows.text: Wow, I always thought the whole "hero who defeated the Antimatter Legion" thing was just hot air.
rows.speaker: Whispering Student

rows.text: In return for the Wishpower offered by everyone in the arcadia, every Supplicant must show them "what elation truly means." We will demonstrate the Elation we desire!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Want attention? Talent? Quick cash? Universal praise? Download the "Sparxie Virus"! Ta-da. Click "Confirm," and you're set.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That hit... gave me chills.
rows.speaker: Whispering Student

rows.text: Chills? You should be impressed! Wow, I wish I could be that strong.
rows.speaker: Whispering Student

rows.text: That's right. Sometimes the Supplicants work together, sometimes they clash... It's like a coin toss. No telling which side will land until the moment it hits the ground
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're one step closer to an audience with Aha. Right now, all of Planarcadia is {RUBY_B#Wishpower}watching{RUBY_E#} you, and all of their attention's flooding over you... and the mask you wear.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Show mercy, or don't... No, no, I'm just kidding. Lower your bat.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Alright, alright... Let what belongs to the Graphia family return to the Graphia family...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Hmph.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Let's go to that classroom, where "time froze fifteen years ago."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Indeed.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I want to investigate and find out who exactly created that place and why.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This place... It's like nothing ever happened. The ghosts are gone.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, during the last Phantasmoon Games, I participated as a Supplicant.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I once believed that all it took for a Supplicant to win was to show the people a magnificent "miracle," and then I'd have an audience with the Aeon of Elation...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: How foolish... how naive I was. Not everyone wants to stir up everyone's Wishpower in a positive way.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: On July 22nd, year 1984 of the Arcadian Calendar, a Supplicant harboring immense malice stepped into Graphia Academy...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: He slaughtered twenty-two students who had stayed behind after school, then went on to Dovebrook District, where one hundred and forty-six innocent civilians were either killed or wounded.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That killer moved like a deranged artist, leaving corpses imprinting his signature mark... the Bloody Bloom. The media dubbed him... the Herald of Death.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It was a tragedy that the world could not forget. The Phantasmoon Games of that year came to be remembered as the "Bloodstained Games"...
So many parents lost their children. So many people lost those dearest to them.
One of the victims... was my very own daughter. Upon my return, I stood before the grave, where she was laid to rest.
...Her name was Himeko.
Forgive me. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Ryusuke, the current dean of Graphia Academy.
So, this lady who bears her name...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...Who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, when I made up my mind to join this Phantasmoon Games, my father wasn't with me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Even as I fought for my life against the Herald of Death, my father was still off somewhere, wandering the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Strictly speaking, ever since I can remember, his presence in my life has been as thin as the air in space...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So, I would ask you who bears his name, who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Soon after, Ashveil arrived at the banks of Dovebrook...
What the heck? I just blinked and suddenly half the Supplicants are wearing masks.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I was hoping this show would get better. Streamers clashing with cosmic heroes, a flashy brawl, without anyone getting hurt. Wouldn't that have been nice?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But now we've got a crow, a shell, a cat, a wolf... how many more mystery guests are crashing this stage?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: And this thing... when did it sneak in?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: In the end, everything always spirals into the abyss.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But you're the rare exception. Your first battle wasn't bad for a greenhorn protagonist.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Since you came out on top, let's wipe the slate clean on that doom-filled oath.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Who knows if the owners of those masks will become your friends or opponents?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Or maybe, one of them will bring about that terrifying future I saw in my dreams...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Little one, how'd you find your way here?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The Supplicants in this Phantasmoon Games really caught me by surprise!
rows.speaker: Evanescia
